name: wrapper-execution
cmd: set -eu; case "${GDP_WRAPPER_RUN:-owned}" in *[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) exit 2;; esac; prefix=runs/wrapper-execution/${GDP_WRAPPER_RUN:-owned}; test ! -e "$prefix"; timeout 90s bun install --frozen-lockfile; NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 bun run build; mkdir -p "$prefix/core" "$prefix/wrapper"; npm pack --json --pack-destination "$prefix/core" > "$prefix/core/core-pack.json"; (cd packages/cli && npm pack --json --pack-destination "../../$prefix/wrapper") > "$prefix/wrapper/wrapper-pack.json"; NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 bun research/security/wrapper-execution.ts --core-pack "$prefix/core/core-pack.json" --wrapper-pack "$prefix/wrapper/wrapper-pack.json" --out "$prefix/evidence" --emit-packet

name: wrapper-static
cmd: timeout 90s bun install --frozen-lockfile && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 bunx tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --types bun --strict --skipLibCheck --noImplicitReturns --noFallthroughCasesInSwitch --noUncheckedIndexedAccess research/security/wrapper-execution.ts && bunx oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --disable-nested-config research/security/wrapper-execution.ts
